description: bucket/v1 — A leaf reconciled by the TypeScript demo worker, composed by tsproject. It depends on an account: its spec.account_id is FILLED BY THE ENGINE from the upstream account's status along the composer's value-flow edge, so the worker just reads the flowed id and derives a bucket name.

account_id.description: The owning account's id. Left absent at compose time — the account→bucket value flow fills it before this leaf runs.
The account id the bucket belongs to (echoed from the flowed spec).
